considerationsSection.title: What We Consider Before Recommending a Venue
considerationsSection.subtitle: A thorough review behind every recommendation we make.

considerations.title: Guest Capacity

considerations.title: Accommodation

considerations.title: Privacy
considerations.desc: We verify whether the property can be fully privatised and whether other guests or events may be present during your wedding.

considerations.title: Location & Transportation
considerations.desc: We evaluate airport access, road conditions, transfer times and transportation requirements between hotels and event spaces.

considerations.title: Catering & Bar Policies
considerations.desc: We review whether catering is provided in-house, whether external caterers are permitted and what restrictions apply to beverages and service.

considerations.title: Sound & Entertainment
considerations.desc: We confirm music curfews, sound restrictions, technical requirements and the feasibility of live entertainment or late-night celebrations.

considerations.title: Weather Contingency
considerations.desc: We assess indoor alternatives, covered spaces and realistic backup plans for outdoor events.

considerations.title: Production Access
considerations.desc: We review supplier access, installation schedules, power capacity, rigging restrictions and logistical requirements for décor, lighting and entertainment.

considerations.title: Overall Investment
considerations.desc: We consider not only the venue rental fee, but also accommodation, catering, staffing, transportation, technical production and additional requirements.

faqs.q: How far in advance should we book a wedding venue in Morocco?
faqs.a: For weddings during high-demand periods, we recommend beginning the venue search approximately 12 to 18 months in advance. Larger weddings, exclusive properties and highly requested dates may require earlier booking.

faqs.q: Can we host several wedding events at the same venue?
faqs.a: Yes. Many villas, resorts, kasbahs and private estates can accommodate welcome dinners, ceremonies, receptions, pool gatherings and farewell brunches. Each venue has different rules, so we confirm what is operationally possible before recommending it.

faqs.q: Can all our guests stay at the venue?
faqs.a: This depends on the property. Some hotels and resorts can accommodate large groups, while private villas, riads and kasbahs usually have limited room capacity. We can organise additional accommodation and guest transportation when required.

faqs.q: Are desert weddings possible near Marrakech?
faqs.a: Yes. The Agafay Desert is located close to Marrakech and offers several venue options for ceremonies, dinners and receptions. More remote desert experiences can also be arranged for couples seeking a longer destination itinerary.

faqs.q: Can we bring our own suppliers?
faqs.a: Supplier policies vary. Some venues permit external suppliers, while others require couples to use approved catering, production or entertainment partners. We review these conditions before confirming the venue.

faqs.q: Do Moroccan venues have music restrictions?
faqs.a: Many venues have specific sound limits or music curfews. We check these restrictions carefully, particularly when couples are planning live music, DJs or late-night celebrations.
Yes. We can coordinate a curated inspection itinerary and accompany you during venue visits, depending on the planning service selected.

faqs.q: Can you plan the entire wedding after helping us find the venue?
faqs.a: Yes. Our full-service wedding planning includes venue management, design, suppliers, accommodation, transportation, guest logistics, entertainment, production and on-site coordination.
